name: Sideway Bounce
description: The picture zooms in and is knocked sideways by a fading wobble with motion smear and a bright glow, cutting to the second clip at the peak before settling back. Recreation of the CapCut "Sideway Bounce" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real length of the transition in seconds; sets the speed of the wobble (0 freezes it, like CapCut exports)
